author: Nick Carter (mrnicholasbcarter-code); code merged in PR 1061

acceptance.criterion: verdict choose --task-class implementation --no-confirm --json on installed main selects a route without sending a model confirmation

first_run.command: .venv/bin/python -m verdict choose --task-class implementation --no-confirm --json | jq -c '{task_class, no_confirm, confirm, gateway, selected: (.selected | {model, capacity_class, capacity_evidence, pool, rank})}'

fresh_run.command: .venv/bin/python -m verdict choose --task-class implementation --no-confirm --json | jq -c '{task_class, no_confirm, confirm, gateway, selected: (.selected | {model, capacity_class, capacity_evidence, pool, rank})}'

stays_true_job: verdict-acceptance.timer runs `verdict choose --task-class implementation` every hour as its choose check

setup_doctor.command: .venv/bin/python -m verdict doctor --json | jq -c '{status, issues, warnings, gateway: [.capability_bootstrap.capabilities[] | select(.capability_id | startswith("gateway.")) | {capability_id, status, health}]}'

parent_confirmation.by: Claude Opus 5.5 subagent (parent confirmation for closeout batch B), not the story author
parent_confirmation.command: .venv/bin/python -m verdict choose --task-class implementation --no-confirm --json | jq -c '{task_class, no_confirm, confirm, gateway, selected: (.selected | {model, capacity_class, capacity_evidence, pool, rank})}'
